source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Radiator and Grille, p.13-1

procedures.title: Radiator and fan shroud: general information
steps: Check coolant level cold: on the Corvette's crossflow radiator it should sit 3 in. below the bottom of the filler neck.

specs.value: three inches below the bottom of the filler neck

notes: Radiators have copper-brass cores, except the Corvette 427 L88 V8 and all 327 V8s with manual transmission, which have aluminum cores.
Only Chevrolet models and the Chevy II 4-cylinder use downflow radiators; the Corvette uses the crossflow design.
All radiators now use a drain cock instead of a drain plug.
Fan shrouds are plastic except on Corvettes without C60, which use steel shrouds.
Radiators mount to the support with cap screws and/or brackets; shrouds attach with cap screws and/or clips.
